text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless-car thesis in the opening and repeated throughout","quality":"position clarity","description":"The essay states a definite stance early and keeps that stance consistent from start to finish."},{"evidence":"three labeled body paragraphs on energy, safety, and convenience","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more cleanly structured, with distinct points that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"uses specific article details like half the fuel, sensors, and Tesla/Mercedes release plans","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its claims in concrete evidence from the source rather than staying general."},{"evidence":"explains how lower fuel use reduces CO2 and pollution","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay does more to connect evidence to broader consequences and show why the details support the argument."},{"evidence":"direct topic sentences and transitions such as 'Safety is a large concern' and 'The convenience of these cars'","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay moves between ideas smoothly and keeps each paragraph focused on one main claim."}]}
